sources.after_removal: outputs/tables/step_timing.json (data[walk_same_E1][planet][m2][variant][device]: f, S, B as published)

processing.welch: Hann, 50 % overlap; 16 s segments standing, 4 s walking
processing.device_spectrum: first singular value of the 3-axis cross-spectral matrix per side, averaged over the records; mean of the left and right device (outcomes.spectra_of)
processing.walking_background: the same walk on rigid ground (rigid-ground twins), same noise realization
processing.structure_psd: ensemble PSD of the structure's vertical acceleration under the person (no noise)
processing.time_series: repetition 0, left device of each pair (wrist_L = watch, thigh_L = phone): magnitude of the specific force with the noise realization of the spectra, over the analysed part; structure: vertical acceleration under the person (no noise)
